name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-vi-victory-fanfare
title: Final Fantasy VI - Victory Fanfare
description:
The Fanfare theme of Final Fantasy VI.

Note that if you want to use this as a goal theme, you will have to add "!" at the end of the following lines:
"default/0F SMW @21.brr"
"default/11 SMW @17.brr"
Note that this may cause incompatibilities with other songs due to ARAM limitations or omission of these samples.
